records.Title: [Post Sales] Partner Delivery Methodology
records.Description: A structured, partner-led approach that aligns joint teams on outcomes, roles, and timelines to ensure successful Glean deployment and adoption across the customer lifecycle.

records.Title: [Post Sales] Realized Outcomes Playbook
records.Description: A strategic guide to define, measure, and communicate business outcomes tied to Glean, ensuring every initiative is anchored in clear KPIs and ROI.

records.Title: [Post Sales] Platform Deployment & Growth Playbook
records.Description: A blueprint for configuring Glean, connecting core systems, and scaling the platform to new teams and use cases over time.

records.Title: [Post Sales] Agent & Prompt Building Playbook
records.Description: A factory-style framework for discovering high‑value use cases, designing, building, and iterating agents and prompts that deliver measurable impact.

records.Title: [Post Sales] Training & Enablement Playbook
records.Description: A programmatic approach to driving org-wide adoption through targeted training, champion networks, and repeatable enablement motions.

records.Title: [Post Sales] Platform Governance (Center of Excellence) Playbook
records.Description: A governance model for standing up a Center of Excellence that owns vision, guardrails, and operating cadence for Glean across the enterprise.
records.Resource / Asset: Partner Enablement_Glean Platform Governance CoE Framework.pdf

records.Title: [Post Sales] Support Optimization Playbook
records.Description: A scalable support model that resolves L1 end‑user issues internally, leverages Glean for self‑service, and streamlines engagement with Glean Support.

records.Title: [Post Sales] Advanced Agent Debugging
records.Description: A technical training playbook that teaches Glean partners advanced, trace-driven techniques to debug agent workflows, diagnose common failures, and execute clean escalations.

records.Title: AWS reference patterns
records.Description: Standard AWS deployment architectures, common customer topologies, shared service/VPC patterns, ingress/egress expectations, and how Glean fits into AWS-hosted environments.

records.Title: Azure reference patterns
records.Description: Azure-specific deployment patterns, tenant/subscription design considerations, networking expectations, and reference architectures for Azure-first customers.

records.Title: GCP reference patterns
records.Description: GCP project/org patterns, VPC design expectations, service boundary guidance, and reference architectures for GCP environments.

records.Title: Networking guidance
records.Description: Firewall rules, allowlisting expectations, private connectivity decision points, DNS/proxy considerations, data path expectations, and troubleshooting patterns for complex networking.

records.Title: Environment strategy
records.Description: When to use sandbox vs pre-prod vs prod, promotion path, validation expectations, test data strategy, and who owns gating decisions.

records.Title: Identity and security architecture
records.Description: SSO patterns, people data dependencies, role/admin model, identity boundaries, app security review expectations, governance, and escalation boundaries.

records.Title: Connector deployment prerequisites
records.Description: What must be ready before connector setup: app ownership, auth method, scopes/permissions, data access approvals, test accounts, validation criteria, and dependency mapping.

records.Title: Custom connector deployment prerequisites
records.Description: API readiness, schema/source constraints, auth model, rate limits, hosting/runtime assumptions, testing approach, support model, and handoff criteria.

records.Title: Cloud operational runbooks
records.Description: Operating procedures for common issues: access failures, connector auth breakage, networking issues, rollout validation, rollback/escalation, evidence collection, and support handoff.

records.Title: Admin and platform operations runbooks
records.Description: Admin workflows for monitoring platform health, managing configuration changes, troubleshooting common issues, and coordinating with the CoE/support model.
